name: codex-review-mcp
description: Ask ChatGPT for a second-opinion review of a document, using your own ChatGPT subscription through the Codex CLI.
long_description: Adds two tools to Claude: chatgpt_review (review a document, with optional focus and rubric) and chatgpt_ask. Requests run through the OpenAI Codex CLI in a read-only sandbox and use your ChatGPT plan; no API key is needed. Document text is sent to OpenAI.

tools.name: chatgpt_review
tools.description: Send a document to ChatGPT for an independent review.

tools.name: chatgpt_ask
tools.description: Ask ChatGPT a question, optionally with context.

codex_path.title: Codex executable (optional)
codex_path.description: Leave blank to auto-detect. Set this if Claude can't find codex (for example C:\Users\you\AppData\Roaming\npm\codex.cmd or /opt/homebrew/bin/codex).

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for ChatGPT before giving up.

model.title: Model (optional)
model.description: Override the Codex model. Leave blank for your Codex default.
